name: resolve
description: Host lookup that never blocks the caller's loop, one API on Linux, macOS and Windows: start, poll, take the addresses, drop to cancel. Linux runs resolver (Go's own resolver) on raw system calls and hands its sockets and deadline to the caller's poll; macOS runs getaddrinfo on a thread; Windows runs GetAddrInfoW on a thread, as Go does; on both, the thread signals through wait, which the caller's poll takes beside its own descriptors.
